title: Text Pipeline with Trait Objects
prompt:
Build a small text-processing pipeline using a trait and dynamic dispatch.

The trait Transform has one method: fn apply(&self, input: &str) -> String.

Implement Transform for these structs:
- Upper: converts the text to uppercase.
- Reverse: reverses the text by characters (not bytes), so multi-byte characters stay intact.
- Replace { from, to }: replaces every occurrence of `from` with `to`.
- Truncate(n): keeps only the first n characters (characters, not bytes).

Then implement run_pipeline(steps: &[Box<dyn Transform>], input: &str) -> String which applies each step in order, feeding the output of one into the next. An empty pipeline returns the input unchanged.

Example:
  steps = [Replace{from:"cat", to:"dog"}, Upper, Reverse]
  run_pipeline(&steps, "my cat") -> "GOD YM"
